rows.en: ＊Amane＊Talking with you is so fun,￥I almost forgot why I came!￥But we've got to train now!＞
＊Amane＊Let's leave it there for now.￥We came here to train, right?＞
＊Amane＊This talk is going nowhere!￥Come on, we've got to￥start training.＞
＊Amane＊I want to talk more, but￥we should start￥training soon, huh?＞
